answer: Grant full weight only to identities with k node-disjoint paths to the honest summit, not merely high flow. One fat edge can carry heavy flow, so measuring flow alone lets a farm attach by a single well-fed bridge. Vertex-connectivity cannot be faked: a cluster joined through a few real nodes has those nodes as cut vertices, and removing them severs the whole cluster. An honest agent reaches the core by many independent routes and lights every beacon; the farm's thousand heads all hang off one bridge and earn as one.
